units.profileReason: The 132-entry property table spells its UTF-16 names with C11 u"..." literals. armcc 4.1 has no C11 character-literal prefix and no preprocessing spelling reproduces a 16-bit string literal, so this one unit keeps the Clang profile until the table is respelled as a recorded reconstruction change. It contributes no byte-identical functions under either compiler today.

excludedSources.reason: Historical void-return setter packet retained as evidence; superseded by abi-qualified/setters.c and excluded from active linking.

warningExceptionReason: Four wave001 scalar functions preserve an observed incoming ABI parameter that is unused by their value-level C semantics. Only the listed function/parameter declarations may issue -Wunused-parameter; all other diagnostics fail.
